metadata.short_desc: Generate AI images and videos through TaoDock's unified AI gateway.
metadata.desc: Generate AI images and videos in AstrBot with one TaoDock API key, discover the models available to that key, and resume long-running video tasks.

api_key.hint: Create a key at https://taodock.com/keys. AstrBot masks this value in the dashboard but stores it in the plugin configuration file.

image_model.hint: Use /td_models image to list image models available to this key.

image_parameters.hint: A JSON object merged into the image request. The plugin always sets model and prompt from the command and configuration.

video_model.hint: Use /td_models video to list video models available to this key.

video_parameters.hint: A JSON object merged into the video request. The plugin always sets model and prompt from the command and configuration.

video_wait_seconds.hint: Seconds to wait before returning the task ID. Set to 0 to check once without waiting.
